items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects three comparison isomorphisms relating the differential forms on a blowup with those on the total space of the exceptional line bundle, on the exceptional divisor and in positive cohomological degree (statement lines 2854-2865). The proof treats the three statements separately: the second by the product decomposition and the projective space computation, the third by the graded direct sum decomposition of the pushforward along the punctured line bundle together with the twisted vanishing on projective space, and the first by reducing to sections over the line bundle vanishing outside the zero section and ruling them out. The three-part reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
